name: Eileen Atkins
bio:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.

Dame Eileen June Atkins, DBE (born 16 June 1934) is an English actress and occasional screenwriter.

credits.title: Bunker
credits.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

credits.overview: When the denizens of Littlehampton – including conservative Edith – begin receiving letters full of hilarious profanities, rowdy Irish migrant Rose is charged with the crime. Suspecting something amiss, the town's women band together to investigate.

credits.overview: Acclaimed actress Dame Siân Phillips is still working at 90. The star of I, Claudius speaks openly about her marriage to Peter O'Toole and reflects on her life and glittering career.
